title: Russian Il-76 transport aircraft crashes in Belgorod region
body:
On 24 January 2024 a Russian Ilyushin Il-76 military transport aircraft crashed in the Korochansky district of Belgorod Oblast, close to the Ukrainian border. The Russian Defence Ministry, as relayed by the state news agency RIA Novosti, said the aircraft was carrying Ukrainian prisoners of war who were being transferred to Belgorod Oblast for an exchange.

According to the Russian Defence Ministry, 74 people were on board: 65 Ukrainian prisoners of war, six crew members and three escorts. The Telegram channel 112 gave a different total of 63 people on board and reported that all of them had been killed. The two Russian accounts of the number aboard were not reconciled in early reporting.

Ukraine's Air Force did not immediately comment but said it would respond later. Ukraine's Defence Ministry told the outlet Suspilne that it could not confirm that Ukrainian forces had shot down the aircraft and that it was still clarifying the information. Ukrinform, citing Ukrainian army sources, reported that the aircraft had been carrying S-300 surface-to-air missiles. The circumstances of the crash were therefore described differently by Russian and Ukrainian sources, and the early accounts could not be independently verified.
